card.name: The word risk in warnings
card.fires_on: The word risk or risks (also hazard) in drug-label warnings, especially right after 'This', 'the', or 'increased'. It also fires weakly on words that come just before a risk statement.

modes.label: Risk noun
modes.description: The noun risk or risks naming a possible harm of a drug.
modes.example: This<< risk>> may occur early in treatment and may increase

modes.label: Words near risk statements
modes.description: Linking words around a risk or harm statement, such as 'and' or 'determine'.
modes.example: Advise patients of these risks<< and>> the need for effective contraception. (

card.writes: The promoted tokens are casual words like heck, pretty, folks and stuff, so there is no clear link to the output.
card.plain: It lights up on the word risk in label warnings about harms of a drug.
